hook: Bharat Future City needs *₹18,000 crore* just for core infra
hook_b: Bharat Future City needs *₹18,000 crore* just for core infra
tldr: The master plan for Bharat Future City is ready, and CM Revanth Reddy is expected to unveil it at the Invest Global Summit on Dec 7-9.

beats.what: The 30,000-acre core area will host 11 sectors over 13,440 acres, including life sciences, electronics, data centres, an AI city and EV industries.
beats.why: Much of the land was acquired earlier for the Hyderabad Green Pharma City; the state now plans a net-zero integrated city on it.
beats.care: Roads, water and power for the new city are being planned now, including a greenfield expressway and substations at Meerkhanpet.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: TOI (Nov 17): about ₹2,000 crore has already been spent on initial infrastructure works, sources said.

cards.q: Would you consider living or working in Bharat Future City?

qs: Where will 164 MLD of water come from in a dry year?
When does Metro or BRT reach the new city?

facts.t: Nearly *164 MLD* of water is planned from Venkatadri reservoir, including 40 MLD recycled.
Over *4,000 acres* are reserved for life sciences; 357 acres for data centres.

viz.verdict: Water and roads take most of the planned spend

watch: The master plan's public unveiling at the Invest Global Summit, Dec 7-9.

sources.name: Times of India
sources.title: Bharat Future City master plan ready, Telangana govt pegs ₹18k crore for core infra

fact: Bharat Future City's core infrastructure alone will cost about *₹18,000 crore*
twist: Officials expect 15 lakh people to live there once it is fully developed.
